name: Talking Head Short
tagline: Raw talking-head clips go in, a tight vertical short with captions and matching visuals comes out.
description: A fast 9:16 short from a recording of you talking to camera. Pauses and earlier takes are cut out (the last take of every line stays), your screen recordings or images show up exactly when you talk about them, and a hook and readable captions sit where phones don't cover them.
bring: Your raw recording of you talking to camera
Optional: screen recordings, images or clips of what you talk about
Optional: where it will be posted and how long it should be
get: A 30–90 s vertical video with tight cuts, a hook, captions and matching visuals

needs.name: Hyperframes, or the video tool your project already uses

steps: Cut the pauses and keep the last take of every line
Pick which picture goes with which line
Add the hook, captions and visuals
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
